facts.statement: The holotype of Spitrasaurus larseni was found in 2010 and is a juvenile skeleton containing cervical vertebrae and skull material.
facts.quote: the holotype of S. larseni, found in 2010, is SVB 1450, a juvenile skeleton which consists of cervical vertebrae but also of skull material

facts.statement: The genus name Spitrasaurus is an abbreviation for Spitsbergen Travel.
facts.quote: It is named after a syllabic abbreviation for Spitsbergen Travel

facts.statement: The species names wensaasi and larseni honor volunteers Tommy Wensås and Stig Larsen, respectively.
facts.quote: Spitrasaurus wensaasi, honouring volunteer Tommy Wensås, and Spitrasaurus larseni honouring volunteer Stig Larsen

facts.statement: Fossils of Spitrasaurus were found between 2004 and 2010 in Spitsbergen within the Agardhfjellet Formation and date to the Middle Volgian.
facts.quote: Sus restos fósiles aparecieron entre 2004 y 2010 en Spitsbergen, en la Formación Agardhfjellet, y se ha datado en el Volgiano medio

facts.statement: A cervical vertebra found in the Kimmeridge Clay Formation in England was tentatively assigned to Spitrasaurus in 2014.
facts.quote: A cervical vertebra, MANCH LL 5519c, was found in the Kimmeridge Clay Formation in England and was tentatively assigned to cf. Spitrasaurus in 2014

facts.statement: Spitrasaurus lived during the Tithonian stage of the Late Jurassic.
Spitrasaurus is known from the uppermost Jurassic of central Spitsbergen, Norway, and likely also from Kimmeridge, England.
facts.quote: known from the uppermost Jurassic of central Spitsbergen, Norway and likely also Kimmeridge, England

facts.statement: Spitrasaurus is an extinct genus of cryptoclidid plesiosaur.
facts.quote: Spitrasaurus is an extinct genus of cryptoclidid plesiosauroid plesiosaur

facts.statement: Spitrasaurus belongs to the family Cryptoclididae.
Spitrasaurus wensaasi is the type species of the genus Spitrasaurus.
The holotype of S. larseni is a poorly preserved juvenile skeleton that includes cranial remains.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo de S. larseni (SVB 1450) pertenece a un plesiosaurio juvenil peor conservado que el anterior, pero con restos craneales

facts.statement: Spitrasaurus lived between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Tithonian (149.2 to 143.1 million years ago)
